Trong bối cảnh thế giới đang chuyển mình: Amid rapid global shifts toward innovation, sustainable development, and international integration, GISA positions Collaboration & Connectivity as a strategic catalyst to build an integrated Knowledge - Action - Policy ecosystem.
GISA chủ động thiết kế các cơ chế hợp tá: GISA actively engineers cross-disciplinary mechanisms, intersectoral forums, and transnational exchange platforms, bridging researchers, corporate innovators, academic experts, policymakers, and grassroots communities.
Các hướng hợp tác chiến lược: Strategic Collaboration Programs and Strategic Initiatives
GISA đóng vai trò xúc tác và điều phối c: GISA acts as a catalyst and coordinator of in-depth collaborative research between universities, science and technology organizations, and experts from multiple disciplines in Vietnam and abroad, co-creating new knowledge, practical solutions, and adaptive implementation models.
GISA phát triển nền tảng dữ liệu động và: GISA develops a dynamic data and matchmaking infrastructure that connects researchers, businesses, and government agencies. By integrating research information, market initiatives, and priority policy issues, the system shortens the distance between research and practical deployment.
GISA tổ chức các diễn đàn chiến lược kết: GISA organizes strategic forums connecting the three impact pillars of academia, policy, and markets. The forums provide a space for dialogue, analysis, critical review, and co-creation to shape solutions, guide policy, and identify research priorities.
Chương trình đồng hành khởi nghiệp và đổ: Sustainable Startup and Innovation Mentorship Hub
GISA hỗ trợ trực tiếp các nhóm khởi nghi: GISA directly supports early-stage ventures, SMEs, and community initiatives through professional mentoring, business model coaching, expert connections, and impact capital connection, with particular focus on initiatives that advance sustainable development and social impact.
GISA xây dựng một trung tâm kết nối giữa: GISA builds a hub connecting the public and private sectors, supporting the design and implementation of flexible, transparent, and effective partnership models — from social infrastructure investment to community innovation initiatives.
GISA Bridge kết nối các nhà khoa học, ch: GISA Bridge connects scientists, engineers, designers, and behavioral experts directly with local communities undergoing socioeconomic transition, focusing on coaching, co-design, and on-the-ground implementation support.
GISA OpenConnect — nền tảng chia sẻ và h: GISA OpenConnect — Open Learning and Knowledge-Sharing Platform
OpenConnect là hệ sinh thái học tập và c: OpenConnect is an open-access learning and knowledge-sharing ecosystem where individuals and organizations can access practical knowledge, applied tools, and interdisciplinary short courses, including digital platforms, tool repositories, learning forums, and communities of practice.
GISA thúc đẩy hình thành và điều phối cá: GISA promotes and coordinates strategic alliances across regions, sectors, and organizations, bringing together localities with distinctive development potential, key industry clusters, and core actors such as leading enterprises, research institutes, expert networks, and community organizations, to share regional resources and multiply shared impact.
Nhóm hình thức này tạo không gian đối th: This group of modalities creates space for multi-stakeholder dialogue, connects experts, and expands resources for research and community initiatives.
Đối thoại chính sách và tư vấn đa bên —: Policy Dialogue and Multi-Stakeholder Advisory — forums, workshops, and multi-stakeholder advisory groups that bring researchers, businesses, communities, and officials together to discuss specific policy issues
Mạng lưới chuyên gia liên lĩnh vực — tập: Interdisciplinary Expert Network — a curated roster of experts in economics, technology, environment, education, and mental health, coordinated by GISA and matched to the projects, policies, and organizations that need their expertise
Bản đồ nghiên cứu và dự án hợp tác mở —: Open Research and Collaboration Map — a digital platform that updates, tracks, and publishes ongoing research, innovation, technology transfer, and community initiatives
Chương trình đồng tài trợ sáng kiến cộng: Community Initiative Co-Funding Program — co-funding with businesses, civil society organizations, or government to support local initiatives with potential for wider impact
Nhóm tiếp theo kết nối hợp tác học thuật: The next group connects academic collaboration with knowledge sharing, mentoring, and local action for sustainable development.
Liên minh học thuật – doanh nghiệp — hợp: Academic-Business Alliance — long-term collaboration among universities, research institutes, and businesses to co-develop training programs, applied research, and human resources
Nền tảng học tập mở và chia sẻ tri thức: Open Learning and Knowledge-Sharing Platform — a digital ecosystem for sharing toolkits, data sets, short courses, academic resources, and implementation models
Mô hình cố vấn và kết nối học tập — kết: Mentorship and Peer Learning — structured one-to-one and peer-to-peer mentoring that links experienced experts with startup teams, local officials, and graduate researchers
Liên kết mạng lưới hành động vì các mục: Local SDG Action Networks — grassroots networks that share initiatives, provide technical support, and connect policy, practice, and communities
